description: Create a new calendar collection on the CalDAV server with optional color, description, timezone, and component types

color.description: Optional: Calendar color in hex format (e.g., #FF5733)

components.description: Optional: Supported component types. Default: ["VEVENT", "VTODO"]. Use ["VEVENT"] for events only, ["VTODO"] for tasks only.

display_name.description: Display name for the new calendar

name: make_calendar
